text: [confident, warm, up-tempo] You've typed this answer before. Probably today.
[easy, a little knowing] So why type it again?
[clear, steady] Save a reply once, and it's waiting in your inbox the next time a customer asks.
[clear, rising] Same good answer, every time, without the retyping.
[bright, announcing] Meet saved replies. New in your support inbox.
[warm, settling] Write it well once. Send it every time.
